0x0303ab42.how: override: opt_ok_hook: the default arm of the second OK handler (048 0x0303a770). 048 tests the level-1 category for 4,0,1,2,3,6,7,8,9,5 and sends anything else (KRAKEN, id 10) to `movi r0,28; movi r1,1; bsr set_mode` at 0x0303ab42. L01 dropped the Record arm (id 6): its chain ends `cmpnei r3,5; bt16 0x03039928`, the same 8 bytes (bsr to set_mode, 0x03034e18 in L01). Unlike 048 the L01 handler has no stack slot (epilogue `pop lr` at 0x03039930); krk_opt_ok is a plain C call that reads only globals, and since L01 also sends id 6 here it now turns that category away (krk_optrow.c).
